files.modifications: Only positiveTokenCount, usageTokenTotal and contextOccupancyTokens are kept, with logic unchanged. The upstream DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW fallback and the remaining-capacity calculations built on it are removed so an unknown context window stays unknown. MessageUsage is imported from ./types/message-stream; formatting follows the Tuff repository.

Keeps the racpError(code, message, options) factory that turn-queue.ts calls, but no RACP server or RacpError/toRemoteError wire type is embedded. The factory returns a WorkspaceQueueError carrying the code and optional queue-capacity details, and maps upstream AGENT_BUSY to Tuff's WORKSPACE_QUEUE_FULL; the retriable table from @pi-desktop/shared is dropped.

Only the QueuedTurnRecord, QueueReorderDirection and QueueStore declarations used by turn-queue.ts are kept. Queue ordering fields (id, sessionId, content, inputHash, numeric priority, createdAt) are preserved; remote RACP principals and permission grants are removed, and an opaque payload carries the Main-validated immutable input. MemoryQueueStore and the other upstream ports are not carried.

Upstream text copied verbatim, including its formatting, with two changes: the LGPL source header is added, and a hold(sessionId) method is added so a stop or failed turn holds pending inputs until an explicit resume. Its ./errors.js and ./ports.js imports resolve to the narrow Tuff adapters in this package.

Logic unchanged. Types are imported from the narrowed ./types/message-stream subset instead of the upstream ./types.js barrel; upstream double-quote/semicolon formatting is converted to the Tuff repository style.
Logic unchanged. Imports point at the sibling ./thinking-levels and ./types/models files instead of the upstream barrel; formatting follows the Tuff repository.

The pure review-evidence logic is translated from Rust to TypeScript: snapshot and preview bounds (16 MiB, 512 KiB, 4000 lines, 2,000,000 LCS cells, 3 context lines), the NUL-or-invalid-UTF-8 binary rule, str::lines splitting, the LCS edit script (diff_ops), hunk construction (make_hunks), line counts and the unchanged-since guard of rollback_change. The LCS table is a flat Uint32Array and the edit script keeps line indices instead of cloned strings; oversized, over-budget and binary previews are reported as separate tooLarge/truncated/binary flags and uncomputed counts are omitted rather than reported as zero. Filesystem access, snapshot directories and rollback I/O are not carried over; Tuff Main owns capture, persistence, locking and authorized rollback.

collect_tool_call_ids, clone_records_for_fork and clone_compaction_for_fork are translated from Rust to TypeScript. Tuff message meta.parts replace upstream content blocks; message, tool-call, turn, compaction, checkpoint and snapshot identity references are remapped to fresh ids while ordinary message text is never rewritten. Only public metadata is carried into a fork: runtime grants, native session pointers, queue state, filesystem paths and approval/rollback authority are stripped, and review evidence stays in private rows handled by Tuff Main. Persistence and Pi native JSONL handling are not carried over.
Logic unchanged. The upstream ./types.js barrel import points at ./types/models; formatting follows the Tuff repository.

Only the UiMessage, MessageUsage, message_update AgentEvent and AgentEventEnvelope fields read by message-stream.ts and context-usage.ts are kept. Upstream-only payloads (model system blocks, voice/session origins, tool rows, plan and permission events) are dropped, hostedSearch is kept opaque, and one field is added: host, the Tuff host projection a snapshot carries and a delta preserves untouched.

Logic unchanged. Only the model vocabulary (upstream lines 1-353) is kept; the theme/appearance types after ModelInfo are dropped because Tuff does not read them. Formatting follows the Tuff repository.
